note: Three curated links added to the dashboard newswire. The feed already carried 1,105 items — 1,052 DashboardLinks and 53 Articles — running from May 7, 2025 (the tracker start) to August 2, 2026, so what was missing was the last few days rather than bulk. Every item here is a real article: the URL came back from a search, was fetched and returned HTTP 200, and the headline, source and date are as published. Nothing is paraphrased into a headline and no URL is constructed. No coordinates are set on any of them, so none produces a map marker — a pin asserts where an event happened, and these are national stories rather than located ones.
